svg.title: Figure 1 — Geometry for deriving Snell's law from stationary optical path
svg.desc: A visibly bent ray travels from A in medium n1 to interface point P and then to B in the illustrated case n2 greater than n1. Vertical distances d1 and d2, horizontal distances x and d minus x, total horizontal distance d, angles theta1 and theta2, and the interface normal are labeled.
svg.text: Figure 1 — Stationary optical path across one planar interface

g.data-original-text: <text class="medium" x="55" y="700">medium 2: n₂ > n₁ (illustrated case)</text>
g.title: medium 2: n₂ > n₁ (illustrated case)
